name: Nextcloud
description: Nextcloud is a self-hosted file storage and sync platform with powerful collaboration capabilities. It integrates Files, Talk, Groupware, Office, Assistant, and more into a single platform. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys Nextcloud as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: File storage, sync, and collaboration platform. Deploy Nextcloud with Docker Compose on Dokploy in minutes – free, open source, self-hosted.
